translations.web: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: For her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts.
